chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Jamil ibn Salih, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding the word of God, Mighty and Majestic:
'Our Lord! Grant us good in the world and good in the Hereafter'
The pleasure of God and Paradise in the Hereafter, and livelihood and good character in this world.

key_terms.الْمَعَاشُ: Livelihood/sustenance — material means of living in this world
key_terms.حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ: Good character/noble morals — a central virtue in Islamic ethics
key_terms.رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ: Pleasure/approval of God — the highest spiritual reward in the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say is meant by 'good in this world and good in the Hereafter' (Quran 2:201)?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides an authoritative Shia interpretation of the famous Quranic supplication in verse 2:201. He identifies the 'good in the Hereafter' as God's pleasure (ridwan) and Paradise, and the 'good in this world' as material livelihood (ma'ash) and noble character (husn al-khuluq). This commentary reflects the Imam's role as the authoritative interpreter of the Quran, and his teaching underscores that worldly wellbeing must be balanced with moral excellence.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel Bin Salih, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Word of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[2:201] Our Lord! Grant us good in the world and good in the Hereafter
: ‘Pleasure of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Paradise in the Hereafter, and the livelihood and the good morals in the world’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Salih who has said the following: “About the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious,
‘O Lord, grant us good in this world and in the next world’,
abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is Allah’s happiness with one, paradise in the next life, good living and excellent moral manners in this world.’”
